title: Adjuster Liaison Guidance: Supported Days of an Insurer Extension by Its Ground (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Guidance.** On a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental, the authorized days of an insurer extension are the lesser of the days the insurer approved and the supported days. The supported days follow the ground of the request: for a supplement delay they are computed from the extension's supplement; for a parts delay they are the days the request asked for, but no more than the class's most days per extension request (5 in every class); for any other ground they are the days the insurer approved.

## Supplement delay

The supported days of a supplement-delay approval are the extension's supplement's labor hours multiplied by its approved share, divided by the repair class's labor hours per production day and rounded up to the next whole day, plus its added days, less the late-request days, never below zero. The labor hours per production day are those of the repair's class under Insurance Claim Repairs.

The supported days run from the day after the insurer coverage end, the rental day on which the days the insurer has authorized on the rental run out, counting rental days from the pickup date as day one. A request reaches the insurer in time when the whole days from its request date to the insurer coverage end day, at twenty-four hours each, are at least the class extension request lead of 24 hours (the same in every class); a request that reaches the insurer later may only cover days from the date of approval, so it loses as late-request days the days from the day after the insurer coverage end up to the day before the decision; a request that reached the insurer in time loses none.

## Grounds at a glance

| Ground of the approved request | Supported days |
|---|---|
| Supplement delay | From the extension's supplement, as above |
| Parts delay | The days asked for, up to 5 |
| Total loss settlement, or any other ground | The days the insurer approved |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Pickup on the 1st; the insurer has authorized 5 days, so the insurer coverage end is day 5, the 5th. A request made on the 4th is 1 whole day, 24 hours, before day 5: in time, no late-request days. A request made on the 5th is late; decided on the 8th, it loses the 6th and 7th, 2 late-request days.
- Supplement delay: 14 labor hours at an approved share of one and a production rate of 6 hours per day give 2.33, rounded up to 3; with 2 added days and no late-request days the supported days are 5. Approved for 4 days, the authorized days are 4.
- Parts delay asking for 7 days and approved for 6: supported days 5, authorized days 5.
